sources.title: Government eTA launch release
sources.publisher: Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis
sources.officialityEvidence: The official government release states the effective date, electronic approval, and limited OECS/citizen no-application exception.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Every visitor must present an approved eTA before travelling to Saint Kitts and Nevis.

sources.title: Electronic Border Management System: eTA
sources.publisher: Ministry of National Security, Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of National Security portal operates the online Immigration and Customs ED Form and eTA service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Official Portal for the Online Immigration and Customs ED Form and Electronic Travel Authorisation

sources.title: Government Citizenship Unit eTA announcement
sources.publisher: Citizenship by Investment Unit, Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis
sources.officialityEvidence: The statutory government Citizenship Unit describes the eTA as the pre-arrival authorisation for visa-free foreign travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: requiring all travellers with visa-free access to apply for authorisation before entering the country.

sources.title: EU–Saint Kitts and Nevis short-stay visa-waiver agreement
sources.jurisdiction: European Union and Saint Christopher and Nevis
sources.officialityEvidence: EUR-Lex publishes the in-force agreement, which covers ordinary passports of every EU Member State except Ireland for short non-paid visits.
sources.supportingExcerpt: citizens of the European Union holding a valid ordinary ... passport may enter and stay without a visa

sources.title: Russian MFA current simplified-entry table
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Russian MFA table explicitly lists Saint Kitts and Nevis as visa-free for Russian citizens.
sources.supportingExcerpt: без визы до 90 дней из каждых 180 дней

sources.title: Ukraine MFA Americas country profile
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Ukrainian MFA country profile identifies the mutual visa-waiver agreement as in force from 27 January 2017.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Agreement ... on mutual abolition of visa requirements ... entered into force on January 27, 2017

policies.title: EU ordinary passports: visa waiver plus eTA
policies.summary: The in-force bilateral agreement waives visas for ordinary passports of all current EU Member States except Ireland; the current eTA remains mandatory.
conditions: The bilateral agreement applies to a valid ordinary passport and a non-paid visit of at most three months in a six-month period.
It defines Member State as every EU Member State except Ireland; this current scope includes Croatia and excludes no other current member.
An approved eTA is required before travel under the operational eTA system; admission remains discretionary and the eTA is not an eVisa.

policies.title: Russian and Ukrainian ordinary passports: visa waiver plus eTA
policies.summary: Current official foreign-ministry records establish visa-free entry for Russian and Ukrainian ordinary passports; the operational eTA remains mandatory.
conditions: Russia: the current Russian MFA table gives Russian citizens visa-free travel for 90 days in each 180 days.
Ukraine: the current Ukrainian MFA country profile identifies the reciprocal waiver agreement and its 27 January 2017 entry into force.
Both remain subject to approved eTA before travel, the ED declaration, document validity, prohibited-person rules, and immigration-officer admission.
